name: Universal Intermodal Services - Jacksonville Terminal - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.siteResolution: Universal Intermodal Services occupies the trailer/container drayage yard portion of a large multi-tenant industrial complex at 2050 Kings Rd, Jacksonville FL, immediately east of the CSX Moncrief rail yard. The complex is shared with an Amazon delivery/sortation tenant (the long dock-door building on the south carries an Amazon banner). 'Bldg 3' in the roster address reflects the multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is perimeter chain-link fenced with swing gates at multiple internal points; access driveways run south off the residential streets (off Kings Rd). No barrier arm seen in Street View, but the fenced yard openings act as controlled truck-gate pinch points — classed as truckGate true / remoteGs true (no staffed booth).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed in any Street View pass of the entrance drives. C-TPAT secure terminal per Universal Intermodal corporate materials implies access control, but it appears gate/fence-based, not a manned shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~28 dock doors estimated; the long dock building is largely Amazon-tenanted, so dock count primarily serves the co-tenant rather than Universal's drayage operation. Universal's own operation is yard + an M&R-style central building with minimal docks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Extensive trailer and chassis storage: a large south trailer-storage lot plus multiple in-complex trailer rows and a stacked-container yard (NE). Clear dedicated drop-yard character.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building complex: warehouse/dock building (Amazon), central M&R building, container yard, plus outbuildings — campus layout.
fieldNotes.railServed: The CSX Moncrief rail yard is immediately adjacent to the west but separated by a tree buffer / drainage canal; no rail spur runs into the Universal-operated property itself — drayage moves are by truck. railServed = false.
